notes.title: Game Announcement, Modern Pink Elf RPG!!!!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!!! Happy 2024!! ːkarrynComfyː

We're happy to announce that we are publishing a new eroge for 2024!! Developed by the talented Sensouya-san (Warshop) and localized by our friends at Cursed Atelier, we're proud to bring you:

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/33020227/3d92962506b8814eeacd72389553acde631fe462.png[/img] 

[h1]Modern Pink Elf RPG![/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2745710/Modern_Pink_Elf_RPG

It's a well done simple eroge RPG with no combat, no leveling. You play as the very pretty Cleome, an pink haired elf that gets teleported to an alternative world in the modern age. And you know what they say about pink hair animes.

Featuring over 50 unique CGs and over 60 scenes, with the 3 main rival interests each getting over 12 escalating scenes. Modern Elf is what you go to when you don't want or need gameplay in your eroge, and you just want to see a big titty elf get porked silly for a few hours. The chicken soup of eroge. No worlds to save, no gods to slay, no family to avenge. Just an elf with a smartphone with a light premise of earning money to go back to her home world and using that to end up having a lot of sexual encounters.

Modern Pink Elf RPG has been a localization work in progress for over a year by our friends at Cursed Atelier, and they are also currently developing their own game so go check out! It's an eroge with gameplay, so when you're done playing Modern Pink Elf RPG and need something more heavy, maybe you go check out their Voidbound, or vice verse when you're done playing something heavy and need a light eroge, come check our Modern Pink Elf RPG!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2500710/VoidBound/

And of course, none of this would've been possible without the talented developer that has been very kind and patience, Sensouya-san (Warshop). ːtonkinBulliedːːlovewaveː

https://twitter.com/enwEJLMiuUIHies

They recently two months ago also released a new eroge in Japanese called NTR Knight, so if you know Japanese definitely go take a look at it if you haven't!

https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ01095162.html
https://ci-en.dlsite.com/creator/4764

Modern Pink Elf RPG will be releasing on February 2nd, 11am PST/1pm EST, and in English, Japanese, SChinese and TChinese!!! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2745710/Modern_Pink_Elf_RPG

Go wishlist it, tell your friends to wishlist it, and tell them to tell their friends to wishlist it!! And we'll see you in February!!

As always, stay up to date by following us on our Discord and Twitter accounts!

notes.title: Karryn's Prison will be releasing on December 15th!!!!
notes.content:
Hello everyone, Rem here!! After three years, it's finally here!! Karryn's Prison will be coming out on Steam on December 15th!!! ːlovewaveː

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33020227/a9777bcb1694e3c79889d94e9181e4d4faaede41.jpg[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1619750/Karryns_Prison

Karryn's Prison is the first indie eroge to be developed from the start for both the Western and Japanese audiences by an American and a Japanese eroge lover from across the ocean, and not only will there be an ingame option to switch between English and Japanese text, there will be an option to switch between English and Japanese voices!!!

All of Karryn's 2000++ battle lines are fully voiced in English AND in Japanese by the two of the industry's most talented voice actresses in their respective languages, SilkyMilk and Tezuka Ryouko!! So this will also be the first indie eroge to release with both English and Japanese voices for over two thousand lines each!!

But going first first first doesn't matter if the actual game is garbage, does it? Karryn's Prison is not a game with sex scenes tacked on, or a porno game with gameplay tacked on. It is a fully featured EROGE where the gameplay and adult elements go hand to hand and are inseparable! 

And what adult elements! Drawn by Japanese art industry veteran Sachinama of Meltys Quest fame, there's almost 10,000 pieces of CGs that gets spliced together during the game to create the battle scenes that you will see ingame!!

And speaking of battle scenes, all the sex in Karryn's Prison takes place in the battle scene! Combined with the Edicts and the Passives systems, how you customize Karryn and Karryn's Prison is up to you once you've begun to master the game's systems after dozens and dozens of hours! And if a single playthrough is not enough for you, there are hundreds of Titles to collect over the course of hundreds of hours of New Game Plus playthroughs!!

I can go on and on but for today, let's celebrate the fact that Karryn's Prison is finally coming out to Steam on December 15th!!!! ːlovewaveː

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33020227/a54b4c797276bb9a518d95e5c5882f441c8f683d.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Welcome to Monster Girl Club Bifrost! Worldwide release!
notes.content:
Welcome dear client, to the newest Monster Girl Club in town! We have a wide range of monster girls to suit your exquisite tastes, from monster girls with wings, or with horns, or with tails to monster girls who are half or even a third of your size, or to ones who tower above you.

Monster Girl Club Bifrost is a strategy simulation game where you, as a debt ridden man, is in charge of training monster girls to prepare them for the nighttime when clients will arrive seeking respite in the arms of a lovely monster girl. Will you succeed in paying back your debt, fall in love with one of your own monster girl, or lose everything for failing to keep up with your debt payments?

Monster Girl Club Bifrost will have a launch discount sale for a week, so grab a copy for yourself and maybe even another copy for your friend or family so that they can stay safe at home in the comforts of Club Bifrost in these trying times! 

Check out our website for more information about Club Bifrost and our other games, and please follow us on social media to stay up to date! Stay safe, stay home with Club Bifrost! ːlovewaveː

notes.title: Meltys Quest v1.2q: Russian Localization and New Games!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! ːmeltysː

Meltys Quest has now been updated to v1.2q, which includes a few bug fixes and RUSSIAN LOCALIZATION!! ːloveWaveː

That's right, Meltys Quest is now available to you in English, Japanese, Chinese, Korean AND Russian! To celebrate, Meltys Quest will be 30% off for the next week!! ːloveWaveː

In addition, we would like to announce the next three games we have been working on all year! First up is Monster Girl Club Bifrost, developed by Midnight Pleasure! In Monster Girl Club Bifrost, you play as a trainer who manages and trains lovely monster girls. Your goal is to pay back your debt to the Grim Reaper within a certain period of time, and the way you make money is to make sure your monster girls can satisfy your clients' demands.

Check out the store page in the link below and wishlist it if it sounds interesting to you!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1150720/Monster_Girl_Club_Bifrost/

The second game is Island SAGA, developed by Kamichichi! In Island SAGA, you play as a male protagonist in a party/harem of four beautiful and well-endowed royal highnesses. Inspired by a certain famous classic RPG series, Island SAGA has hours of gameplay and PLOTS. Your goal is to just have fun adventuring with your stunning companions, and oh, find a legendary treasure while you're at it. 

Check out the store page in the link below and wishlist it if it sounds interesting to you!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1150730/Island_SAGA/

The third game is Karryn's Prison, and it is being developed inhouse with the same people that brought you Meltys Quest! Currently there is no Steam store page for Karryn's Prison because it is still in early development, but you can follow the development news for it on our Patreon, Twitter or Discord!

Speaking of which, once you've wishlisted Monster Girl Club Bifrost and Island SAGA on Steam, why not follow us on Twitter, Discord and Patreon also!

Meltys Quest was the first eroge where an indie Japanese developer and an indie American developer worked together to bring a high quality product simultaneously to both the Japanese and English markets at the same time. It also heralded the beginning of the standard of quality on Steam being raised for English localizations of indie Japanese eroges. There are plenty of talented indie Japanese eroge developers out there that deserve much, much more than their games being sold for pennies on Steam with a machine translation and broken scripts. The users on Steam also deserve better for their precious time and hard earned money! :meltys:

Just as Meltys Quest heralded a new age of cooperation and awareness with Japanese indie eroge developers, we hope to herald another new age of uncensored Japanese eroge onto Steam. To celebrate this joyous occasion, Meltys Quest will be on sale from September 12 to September 23 for 30% off!

The sale starts tomorrow, but the uncensor update will be live today! So if you’re impatient or want to support the cause, you’re more than welcome to purchase Meltys Quest today for yourself or for someone you know! :lovewave:

If you’ve already brought Meltys Quest, then help spread the word and tell your friends and family: "The new age of uncensored eroges on Steam has just began!!! Viva La Eroge!!" :lovewave::meltys:

notes.content:

The retail price will be $20.00, with a launch and Halloween discount of 40% for the first week. The CGs and pictures for the Steam release will be censored, but there will be a day one patch released for free on my Patreon to remove all the CG censors.

As a celebration for Steam approving the game for release, I'm going to do a tiny, silly giveaway contest. Let's play WHO'S THAT MONSTER GIRL!

This contest is also concurrently being run on [url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/october-19-2017-14952929]my Patreon[/url], so essentially you can have up to two guesses if you try to guess on both sites. This contest will run until 10/20 Friday 10PM Eastern Time.

There's still plenty of time to try out the demo before you see if you can figure out her naming scheme. Below is a sample of her in-game introduction:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30885323/5335207ac33aefa5ae86752226e9a3b4a3cfd9fa.jpg[/img][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30885323/40a6ffb4ba4f016885df283878ea93a7862bf138.jpg[/img][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30885323/b5952123d1c2215e36fd002011a3e0a0f8ad162c.jpg[/img]

No hard feelings if you don't win, it's pretty tricky! Look forward to having a Happy Meltys Day on October 24th!

Please look forward to more details and updates in the coming days and weeks as we get closer to release!
